metadata.description: A marketplace of individually-installable commands and skills for Claude Code.

plugins.name: claude-md-audit
plugins.description: PreToolUse hook that lints CLAUDE.md on every Edit/Write and blocks writes that introduce structural errors. Example of a plugin-scoped hook.

plugins.name: audit-agent-overhead
plugins.description: Audit a Claude Code setup (global ~/.claude, project .claude, plugin scope) for the 9 token-waste patterns that silently inflate cost and burn through usage limits. Slash-only.

plugins.name: agent-loop
plugins.description: Goal-driven loop harness: /agent-loop init|new|run|approve|reject|status|doctor|canonize. Builds the 7-file Claude Code harness in any repo, then runs goal-spec-driven plan→act→verify→optimize loops with human plan approval, stall detection and scheduler integration — each pass proposes spec/verify improvements for the next.

plugins.name: agentic-engineering
plugins.description: Composable skills for AI-agentic engineering: PRD → issues → spec → rubric → autonomous work pipeline, orchestrated end-to-end by /feature (3 human checkpoints, resumable) or run piece-by-piece. Plus TDD, architectural deepening, bug diagnosis, prototyping, domain interrogation (CONTEXT.md/ADR-aware), navigation, evolutionary search, CRAP-score reduction, and ARCHITECTURE.md mapping.
